items.title: Happy Days
items.line: Premiered on ABC on 15 January 1974 and ran 255 episodes. Ron Howard got the lead after Lucas cast him in American Graffiti off the 1972 pilot.

items.title: California Jam
items.line: On 6 April 1974 Ontario Motor Speedway drew a crowd put at 175,000 to 250,000 for the Eagles, Seals & Crofts, Earth, Wind & Fire and Deep Purple. Tickets were $10 in advance.

items.title: Hank Aaron's 715th
items.line: On 8 April 1974 in Atlanta, Aaron hit home run 715 off the Dodgers' Al Downing and passed Babe Ruth's record of 714.

items.title: Chinatown
items.line: Roman Polanski's film opened on 20 June 1974, built on the Los Angeles water wars. It had 11 Oscar nominations and Robert Towne won for the screenplay.

items.title: Nixon resigns
items.line: Richard Nixon resigned on 9 August 1974, two years after the Watergate break-in.

items.title: The Rumble in the Jungle
items.line: Muhammad Ali knocked out George Foreman in the eighth round in Kinshasa on 30 October 1974. Each fighter was paid $5 million.
